Bayesian-bootstrap optimism correction for a scalar validation metric.

Source: R/optimism.R
bb_optimism.Rd

Bayesian-bootstrap optimism correction for a scalar validation metric.

Usage

bb_optimism(
  fit_psurv,
  data,
  metric_fn,
  B = 50L,
  summarise = stats::median,
  seed = 1L
)

Arguments

fit_psurv

function(data, weights) -> a psurv fitted on data (weights are Dirichlet case weights; pass to the fitter or ignore if it resamples internally).

data

the evaluation data.frame.

metric_fn

a per-draw metric function metric_fn(draw, w) -> scalar (single-value; if it returns a vector the first element is used).

B

number of Bayesian-bootstrap replicates.

summarise

function to collapse a metric's posterior draws to a point (default median).

seed

RNG seed.

Value

list with $apparent (on full data), $optimism (mean and per-rep), and $corrected = apparent - mean(optimism).
